description.value: A legendary Alaska Highway lodge-stop at Mile 375 with tenting at $25/night (showers and WiFi included), famous for fresh-baked cinnamon buns and house-made artisan meats; gates close at 5pm daily and the season runs to October 1st.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a privately operated campground and lodge at Historic Mile 375 on the Alaska Highway, run by the Andrews family for three generations. The RV & Campsites page explicitly states tenting is welcome and lists onsite water, sewer, wifi, showers, and a dump station. The on-site cafe serves breakfast, homemade soups, breads, and artisan meats, confirming food availability. OSM phone (+1-250-774-1005) differs from the website footer phone (1-780-882-3248), which is a notable discrepancy. OSM shower=yes tag is corroborated by the website's mention of a shower/washroom building.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-250-774-1005 but the website footer consistently shows 1-780-882-3248. The website value was used.
OSM name is 'Tetsa River Campground' but the website primarily uses 'Tetsa River Lodge'; footer reads 'Tetsa River Services & Campground'. OSM name retained per rules.
Seasonal operation: website indicates open to October 1st, Tuesday through Sunday only.
Website GPS coordinates (59°39'9"N) do not match OSM latitude (58.6524°N); OSM value appears more consistent with the stated 74 miles from Fort Nelson.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground on the Alaska Highway that welcomes tent campers, with on-site showers, potable water, wifi, and a cafe — a valuable stopover for touring cyclists between Fort Nelson and Liard Hot Springs.
enrichment_extras.notes: Also offers cabins and an on-site gift shop/bookstore. Pet friendly. Wifi included with tenting. Gas and diesel available on site.

wow_evidence: legendary Alaska Highway lodge-stop at Mile 375…run by the Andrews family for three generations
